title: Numbers in Order
short: Put the numbers 0 to 10 in order and find a missing one.

blocks.html: Numbers go in order, from 0 all the way up. Later numbers are bigger. If one number is missing, can you find it?

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: Which number is hiding under the question mark?

blocks.html: Count along: the missing number is the one you say in the gap.

For the grown-up: Make a number path on the floor with tape or chalk, 0 to 10. Hop along and say each number. Cover one with a shoe and ask what is underneath. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Hop on a chalk number path.
Put number cards in order on the floor.
Hide a card and guess the missing number.

sources.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (ELOF), Mathematics Development, preschool goals P-MATH 1 to 10
